title: Classic Pong Game with HTML, CSS & JavaScript | Pure Frontend Fun!
description:
🚀 New Game Project Alert!
I just built a Classic Pong Game using only HTML, CSS & JavaScript, and it’s surprisingly fun to play! No libraries. No dependencies. Just raw code and creative logic. 🧠💻

Here’s what’s inside: 👇

🎮 Gameplay Features:

  • 🏓 2-player local controls

  • 💡 Real-time paddle movement with keyboard support

  • 🟡 Dynamic ball with speed increase on paddle hit

  • 🔄 Score tracking and reset button

  • 🧱 Collision detection (walls, paddles, goals)

🧩 Tech Stack:

  • HTML5 Canvas for the game field 🎨

  • CSS3 for layout and styling 🎯

  • Vanilla JavaScript for game logic and controls ⚙️

💻 Controls:

  • Player 1: W (up), S (down)

  • Player 2: ↑ (up), ↓ (down)

📌 What You’ll Learn Building This:

  • How to use <canvas> in HTML5

  • Game loops and setTimeout mechanics

  • Keyboard event handling

  • Object collision detection

  • Basic game state management

🔁 Want to reset the match? Just hit the Reset button and go again! 💥
This is a perfect beginner-friendly project if you want to learn game logic with web tech.
